directions.name: The Screening Room
directions.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a truly art-directed, production-quality cinematic marketing website concept for MaxVideoAI, an existing multi-model AI video creation and comparison platform. This is a radical visual exploration, not a faithful clone. Direction name: THE SCREENING ROOM. One independent concept, no option numbers, no presentation board or multiple variants.
Target: a 1440px wide scrollable desktop webpage shown as one tall clean 1440x2400 composition, page content only. English master. Current date 2026-09-10; do not invent dates, awards, customers or metrics.
Attached image 1 is the existing homepage: use brand name/mark and product purpose as grounding, NOT its boxed layout or white template. Attached image 2 is the live comparison page: retain clarity, prominence of scores and explanation of criteria; do NOT reproduce pricing.
Visual direction: a film premiere experienced as a usable website. Ink-black and charcoal, warm natural film highlights, sharply set warm-white typography. Huge borderless widescreen cinematic imagery; precision editorial composition and intentional visual density. One restrained acid-yellow accent for the primary CTA and a small playhead. Elegant sans-serif with a confident condensed display headline. No glassmorphism, floating dashboard windows, cubes, laptops, sci-fi tunnels, neon grids, stars, gradients as decoration, pill badges, box-in-box layouts, generic agency template, giant empty gaps.
Show three main consecutive moments on this ONE webpage:
1. Opening frame ~45%: extremely compelling realistic cinematic image of a woman in an ochre coat in a rain-darkened city at dusk, reflected amber lights, atmospheric depth, natural film grain, no stock-photo smile. She is small in a very wide dramatic composition. Superimpose finely typeset bold headline at left: "AI video. Directed by you." Short copy: "Compare models. See real outputs. Create with the price upfront." Primary button "Create a video"; secondary "Explore examples". Logo MaxVideoAI at top left; slim top navigation Models, Compare, Connect, Pricing. Real product, not a film streaming service. Small unobtrusive label "Art direction study" makes imagery an illustration, not a claimed model output.
2. Casting gallery ~20%: heading "Every model has a character." A horizontal edge-to-edge strip of large distinct cinematic stills at different crops, with aligned names MiniMax, Seedance, Kling, Wan, LTX and modest official-style marks informed by screenshot. Composition suggests a film strip traveling horizontally on scroll, not individual rounded cards. Tiny index and a fine shared track.
3. Compare ~35%: "See the difference." Two large model identities facing each other, Kling 3 Pro / Seedance 2.5, angular framing, cinematic stills ABOVE a genuinely readable precise comparison instrument integrated into the black page. Published editorial scores only: Prompt adherence 8.6 / 9.1, Visual quality 8.4 / 9.2, Motion realism 8.4 / 9.2. Draw generous numbers and calibrated opposing bars with clear criterion labels, subtle green/amber difference signals like the live source but sophisticated and restrained. Label "MaxVideoAI editorial scores / 10" and action "Explore the full comparison". Suggest motion through a fine playhead and staggered alignment, but no diagram arrows outside UI. No fake overall score or live fluctuations.
Keep body text legible at 14-16px equivalent or larger, fully rendered sensible English, at most two font families. Layout must already feel outstanding paused. This is a decisive cinematic visual target for later responsive code, not a screenshot of a generic SaaS landing page.

directions.name: The Director’s Cut
directions.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a highly finished cinematic marketing homepage design for MaxVideoAI, an AI video generation and model comparison platform. One independent visual concept, name THE DIRECTOR'S CUT, no option number, no surrounding presentation board.
Target dimensions: a 1440px wide scrollable website, shown as one tall 1440x2400 image. English master. Date anchor 2026-09-10, no fabricated statistics, awards, customers or time-sensitive claims.
Attached homepage is a grounding reference for the real brand and purpose. Attached scoreboard is a grounding reference for meaningful score emphasis, criterion explanations and contrast. This is a redesign, not a clone. Do not reproduce its cards or prices.
Art direction: a beautifully edited film journal meets a contemporary creative tool. Warm ivory stock, almost-black ink, one vermilion-red accent, exceptionally crisp grotesk typography with a refined italic serif used sparingly for one expressive word. Sculptural typography and dense cinematic imagery with asymmetry and deliberate crops. Premium contemporary cinema culture; not retro scrapbook, not a generic white SaaS template. Avoid rounded containers, floating cards, laptop mockups, cubes, window mockups, corporate stock, giant blank whitespace. Fit purposeful content comfortably, no tiny labels replacing all information.
One coherent page with three developed sections:
Opening: narrow typographic navigation MaxVideoAI / Models / Compare / Connect / Pricing / "Create a video". Headline "Make the scene you have in mind." Large tight typography integrated with a spectacular borderless photographic panorama: a windswept coastline with a solitary figure in ochre outerwear, warm low sun cutting through a dark sky, subtle anamorphic character, photographic not fantasy illustration. Strong editorial juxtaposition of dramatic image and real product copy "AI video models, real examples and clear pricing — in one workspace." Short primary Create a video and Explore examples. Tiny "Art direction study". Some image elements extend to the grid edges; no outer shadow.
Middle: "Cast the right model." An expressive horizontal contact-sheet composition with staggered but aligned image crops, some portrait, some landscape. Large photographic subjects from varied film genres, labels MiniMax, Seedance, Kling, Wan, LTX. A red editorial index moves conceptually across the lineup; film stills have generous visual weight, not tiny logos. Arrange it to naturally become a horizontally moving rail on desktop and swipeable on mobile.
Lower: premium comparison integrated into an ivory-to-ink chapter break. Title "The difference is in the details." Two strongly drawn typographic identities Kling 3 Pro and Seedance 2.5, clear official-style marks from the reference. Use only these real editorial values: Prompt adherence 8.6 vs 9.1; Visual quality 8.4 vs 9.2; Motion realism 8.4 vs 9.2. Large aligned numbers, thin precise scale marks, confident solid bars, clear criterion labels and text "MaxVideoAI editorial scores / 10". Show a single foreground criterion emphasis, other rows remain readable. Primary "Open full comparison". Bottom teaser "Your project. Your assistant. Your video." with Claude / Codex / ChatGPT as a restrained text line, not a logo cloud.
This should feel like a distinctive high-end film brand with a functional product, not a portfolio or streaming service. Maximum two fonts, readable 14-16px equivalent body, one clear primary action per section, realistic polished UI and flawless visual hierarchy. Do not fake an overall winner or put a score on generated illustrative imagery.

directions.name: The Continuous Shot
directions.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Design one striking, highly art-directed cinematic marketing homepage for the existing AI video platform MaxVideoAI. Direction name THE CONTINUOUS SHOT. This is one distinct webpage concept, no option numbers, no surrounding moodboard, no multiple alternative layouts.
Target: 1440px wide scrollable desktop site, shown as a single tall 1440x2400 image. English master. Current date 2026-09-10. Ground brand and product details in attached screenshots, but completely rethink the existing card-based visual system. Attached second image grounds published model comparison clarity; don't reproduce prices.
Aesthetic: an uninterrupted cinematic visual world flowing through the homepage. Midnight petrol, silver-white type and genuine warm light from photographs, an elegant very restrained orange accent. Dense image-led composition with layers of photographic depth and intentional changes in scale. Extremely sophisticated editorial typography. The motion concept is a camera traveling from a project's reference into its resulting film, retaining the same identifiable subject throughout. NO decorative sci-fi geometry, glossy cubes, floating browser cards, laptop, funnels, tubes, glowing networks, stock-office scenes, endless logo clouds or redundant separators.
Opening ~40%: MaxVideoAI mark/name from reference, very quiet top navigation Models / Compare / Connect / Pricing, "Create a video". Large expressive headline "Your next film starts here." Short useful text "Explore AI video models. Compare the results. Create from a prompt, an image or your project." Primary "Create a video" and supporting "See examples". Full-bleed arresting photographic cinematic image of a performer in an ochre coat moving through a huge empty concrete concert hall, dramatic skylight shaft, warm dust in the light, strong geometry and atmospheric depth, tangible and credible cinematography. Small "Art direction study".
Central developed Connect chapter ~40%: "Your project becomes the story." Underline benefit "Create with Claude, Codex or ChatGPT." Depict a clear continuous visual transformation across the actual web layout, NOT a random collection of floating objects. On the left a flat recognizable website editorial spread for an illustrative performing-arts project with an ochre costume photo and its amber/black visual identity, labelled "Your project". In the middle a clean editorial storyboard of THREE substantially different shots of that SAME performer and hall (wide hall, costume texture close-up, moving performer), aligned to a fine timeline, labelled "Plan & approve". At the right a large immersive final cinematic frame of the SAME performer in dynamic motion in the SAME hall, labelled "Your video". Subject and identity must survive every stage; the output is meaningfully changed from a static website into a directed sequence. Use overlapping photographic crops and depth of field for continuity, but all text lives on a flat readable surface. No beveled browser windows or pseudo-3D widgets. A modest realistic line "Review the plan and price before generation." and CTA "Connect your assistant". Tiny "Illustrative workflow" avoids claiming actual generated proof.
Lower ~20%: the film pulls back into a lateral lineup of models MiniMax / Seedance / Kling / Wan / LTX with real-looking marks and photographic previews, heading "Choose your creative range." A compact but premium two-model comparison teaser integrated below: Kling 3 Pro and Seedance 2.5, "Visual quality", actual editorial values 8.4 and 9.2 out of 10, two solid clear calibrated bars, label "MaxVideoAI editorial scores". Action "Compare models". This is product navigation, not arbitrary decorative metrics.
Show excellent visual craft at every edge: image grading, spacing, type, CTA, menu, aligned rules. Use at most two fonts, readable body sizes equivalent 14-16px or more, no excessive text and no giant empty sections. The story must be understandable in this still image before any animation is built.
